summary: H2O America filed an 8-K reporting that on October 1, 2026, its indirect subsidiary SJWTX, Inc. (TWC) completed the acquisition of substantially all water and sewer utility assets of Quadvest, L.P., while affiliate Texas Water Operation Services, LLC acquired Quadvest Wholesale, LLC's wholesale water and sewer assets. The combined base purchase price was $540 million, subject to customary adjustments; no per-share price or premium applies as this is an asset deal. The transactions closed immediately, with a press release furnished under Item 7.01. What to watch: integration of the acquired Texas utility operations, rate-base growth, and any purchase-price adjustments disclosed in future filings.
